title: 📰 AI news · October 25

items.title: A forgotten key opened the door to a malicious LiteLLM release
items.text: In May the LiteLLM team put its master key in a public repository and never revoked it. On October 21 an attacker released a malicious version that stole OpenAI, Anthropic and AWS keys. If you run a bot or an AI agent, its keys may sit in similar files. Check whether your project still holds old keys that were never revoked. Free guide «Code Protection in One Prompt»: send the word «protection» to the bot.

items.title: A flaw in Brotli reached Node.js, Bun and Python
items.text: Researchers found a flaw in Brotli, a compression library: specially crafted data can run foreign code. Fixes are out for Node.js, Bun and the Python packages. If your site or bot runs on these tools, it may use such a library. Check which versions your project has.

items.title: Block released the voice model Dessa
items.text: The model runs on the device itself, with no cloud, and talks and listens at the same time. The voice is expressive, with laughs and pauses. It is not public yet.

items.title: Google: Gmail and Photos data may shape ads
items.text: Since October 16 Google's policy says personalized AI features in Search and Gemini may use data from other services for ads. You can turn it off in personalization settings.

items.title: Apple set an event for October 28
items.text: The event takes place in Los Angeles. Reports expect the first MacBook with a touch OLED screen. Apple has not confirmed it.

items.title: Oppo Find X10 went global
items.text: The Pro Max has three 200-megapixel cameras, a 2-nanometer chip and a 144 Hz screen. European prices are 1,300 and 1,800 euros.

items.title: Huawei opened preorders for the Pura 90 Plus
items.text: The phone gets the new Kirin 9025 chip and up to 1 TB of storage. The launch is on October 28, with the price announced then.

takeaway: Today's news covers a forgotten key and a shared library used by thousands of projects. Both show that access keys and third-party code stay in a project longer than it seems. Recommendation: find old keys in your project and revoke the ones you no longer need.
